description: This file defines a utility enum 'SystemSettingsURLSupport' with a static method to open the first compatible URL from a list, used for opening system settings URLs in macOS.

classes.name: SystemSettingsURLSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing a method to open system settings URLs.

methods.name: openFirst
methods.description: Iterates over a list of URL strings and attempts to open the first valid URL.
